claim: Exact prefix compatibility in the fixed image-verified reported-Greek-form person-period PILOT. Not a complete eligible Ilan corpus or historical identification.

lemma_alias_rule: Unique normalized reported Greek FORMS. name_id is a SHA256 form ID, not a distinct onomastic lemma/person. Repeated occurrences/source citations are preserved separately without weighting; slash alternatives kept only when sourceGreek and clear.
normalization: Unicode NFD before uppercasing; remove combining accent/breathing marks; sigma/final/lunate sigma to Σ. Only one token composed of the 24 modern Greek uppercase letters accepted; punctuation, spaces, restorations and other alphabets rejected. Iota subscript rejected and logged; no automatic transliteration or editorial reconstruction. Lunate epsilon in the scroll reading is edition-based Ε, not an unrestricted input character replacement.
reading_scope: Edition-based. The 12 combinations are a deliberately broad sensitivity envelope, not 12 coherent published editions. Preserve the individual editions and uncertainty in the evidence record. Proposed ΚΑΓειρας does not license ΚΑΓ. Puech’s cancelled Ι in {Ι}ΣΚ is inactive. Unresolved strokes remain unresolved; no reading chosen by name fit.
control_rule: Primary exact null: independent slot prefixes uniformly sampled conditional on each C/V pattern (CVC,CVC,VC,CV,CV,CC,CC), with seven vowels/seventeen consonants. Secondary uniform 24-letter null. Union controls preserve shared tails and number of distinct alternative first letters; nested ΤΡΙ is subsumed by ΤΡ for existence matching. Exact slot probabilities and Poisson-binomial tail; disclose all branches, primary and union, no selection of smallest tail. This artificial letter null is not a historical language-generating model or a personal-initial likelihood ratio.
exposure_limit: All seven groups, Josephus and previously proposed persons are already exposed. No verified unused observation. Entire run exploratory; a newly downloaded corpus is not automatically a holdout.
decision_rule: Disclose exact pilot matches/misses, all primary/union/branch tails under artificial letter controls. No book-wide negative, no universal historical-compatibility decision, no person/meaning/hand identification. Incomplete parser detection/eligibility and unused-observation gaps remain. Historical initials meaning stays not identifiable from available evidence.
